tai.method: dos Reis genomic anticodon copy number
tai.lysidineConvention: Ile-CAT is represented as LAT and decodes ATA with s=0.89; Met-CAT remains a separate six-copy species decoding ATG
tai.decodingPoolExclusion: Excluded tRNA species remain in the reported species table but do not contribute to elongator codon weights.

expressionProxy.method: tie-aware average rank of sqrt(CAI * tAI), scaled across all genes to the closed interval [0, 1]
expressionProxy.meaning: codon-adaptation proxy rank, not transcript or protein abundance

deltaEncConvention: expected Wright neutral-curve ENC minus observed ENC
encFamilyConvention: families with fewer than two observations use the mean F of estimable families in the same degeneracy class; an entirely unestimable class uses neutral F=1/k
encExpectedGc3Convention: GC3s over synonymous sites, excluding Met and Trp
rscuAbsentFamilyConvention: zero for every codon in an absent amino-acid family

gc.label: GC
gc.desc: Fraction of G or C bases across the sense CDS, excluding the terminal stop; ranges from 0 to 1 and is computed from the RefSeq coding sequence.
gc.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

gc1.label: GC1
gc1.desc: Fraction of sense codons with G or C at codon position 1; ranges from 0 to 1, excludes the terminal stop, and is computed from the RefSeq coding sequence.
gc1.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

gc2.label: GC2
gc2.desc: Fraction of sense codons with G or C at codon position 2; ranges from 0 to 1, excludes the terminal stop, and is computed from the RefSeq coding sequence.
gc2.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

gc3.label: GC3
gc3.desc: Fraction of sense codons with G or C at codon position 3; ranges from 0 to 1, excludes the terminal stop, and includes Met and Trp sites unlike the GC3s value used for expected ENC.
gc3.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

a3.label: A3
a3.desc: Fraction of sense codons with A at codon position 3; ranges from 0 to 1, excludes the terminal stop, and is computed from the RefSeq coding sequence.
a3.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

t3.label: T3
t3.desc: Fraction of sense codons with T at codon position 3; ranges from 0 to 1, excludes the terminal stop, and is computed from the RefSeq coding sequence.
t3.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

g3.label: G3
g3.desc: Fraction of sense codons with G at codon position 3; ranges from 0 to 1, excludes the terminal stop, and is computed from the RefSeq coding sequence.
g3.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

c3.label: C3
c3.desc: Fraction of sense codons with C at codon position 3; ranges from 0 to 1, excludes the terminal stop, and is computed from the RefSeq coding sequence.
c3.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

enc.label: ENC
enc.desc: Effective number of codons (Wright 1990), ranging from 20 for maximal synonymous concentration to 61 for equal synonymous use. Families observed fewer than twice use a degeneracy-class estimate; 1,744 of 4,227 genes (41%) require at least one such substitution, flagged by encHasSubstitutedFamilies.
enc.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

encExpected.label: Expected ENC
encExpected.desc: Expected effective number of codons on Wright's neutral curve, calculated from GC3 at synonymous sites after excluding Met and Trp; it is a compositional expectation, not a measured optimum.
encExpected.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

deltaEnc.label: Expected ENC − observed
deltaEnc.desc: Expected ENC minus observed ENC, in codons and centred on zero; positive values mean more codon concentration than the GC3s neutral curve predicts, subject to the ENC family-substitution caveat.
deltaEnc.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

cai.label: CAI
cai.desc: Codon adaptation index (Sharp and Li), ranging from 0 to 1 and calculated against the 79-gene translation-machinery reference set; zero reference counts receive a 0.5 pseudocount and Met and Trp are excluded.
cai.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

tai.label: tAI
tai.desc: tRNA adaptation index (dos Reis et al.), ranging from 0 to 1 and derived from this genome's tRNA gene copies with bacterial wobble penalties; every sense codon has a cognate or wobble-compatible tRNA.
tai.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

expressionProxy.label: Expression proxy rank
expressionProxy.desc: Tie-aware average rank of sqrt(CAI × tAI) across all genes, scaled from 0 to 1; this is a codon-adaptation proxy, not measured transcript or protein abundance.

rareFraction.label: Rare codon fraction
rareFraction.desc: Fraction of sense codons whose genome-wide within-amino-acid frequency is below 0.1; ranges from 0 to 1 and treats an alternative start codon as translated methionine.
rareFraction.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

rareCount.label: Rare codons
rareCount.desc: Number of sense codons whose genome-wide within-amino-acid frequency is below 0.1; ranges from 0 to the gene's sense-codon length and excludes the terminal stop.
rareCount.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

longestRareRun.label: Longest rare run
longestRareRun.desc: Longest consecutive run of sense codons whose genome-wide within-amino-acid frequency is below 0.1; ranges from 0 to the gene's sense-codon length.
longestRareRun.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

rampRareCount.label: Rare codons in first 50
rampRareCount.desc: Count of rare codons in the first 50 sense codons, or the whole gene when shorter; ranges from 0 to min(50, protein length) and uses the genome-wide 0.1 frequency threshold.
rampRareCount.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

minLocalTai.label: Minimum local tAI
minLocalTai.desc: Minimum mean tRNA-adaptation weight across all sliding 9-codon windows, shortened to the whole gene when necessary; ranges from 0 to 1 and inherits the tAI convention; every sense codon has cognate or wobble-compatible support.
minLocalTai.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

cps.label: Codon-pair score
cps.desc: Mean Coleman-style codon-pair log odds over adjacent sense-codon pairs; signed around zero and estimated from this genome after conditioning on the encoded amino-acid pair, with a 0.5 pseudocount.
cps.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

underrepresentedPairFraction.label: Underrepresented pair fraction
underrepresentedPairFraction.desc: Fraction of adjacent sense-codon pairs with a negative genome-derived codon-pair log-odds score; ranges from 0 to 1 and is zero for genes with no pair.
underrepresentedPairFraction.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

mfeStart.label: Start-region MFE
mfeStart.desc: Minimum folding free energy for the genomic RNA window from 30 nt upstream through 60 nt downstream of the translation start; reported in kcal/mol by ViennaRNA and includes flanking sequence rather than only the CDS.
mfeStart.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

mfeFirst100.label: First-100-nt MFE
mfeFirst100.desc: Minimum folding free energy of the first 100 nt of the CDS, or the entire CDS when shorter; reported in kcal/mol by ViennaRNA and computed on the fixed wild-type window.
mfeFirst100.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

minLocalGc.label: Minimum local GC
minLocalGc.desc: Minimum GC fraction across all sliding 30-nt CDS windows, shortened to the whole CDS when necessary; ranges from 0 to 1 and includes the terminal stop when it falls in a window.
minLocalGc.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

maxLocalGc.label: Maximum local GC
maxLocalGc.desc: Maximum GC fraction across all sliding 30-nt CDS windows, shortened to the whole CDS when necessary; ranges from 0 to 1 and includes the terminal stop when it falls in a window.
maxLocalGc.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

gc5prime.label: 5′ GC
gc5prime.desc: GC fraction in the first 30 nt of the CDS, or the whole CDS when shorter; ranges from 0 to 1 and uses the fixed 5-prime window.
gc5prime.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

lengthNt.label: CDS length
lengthNt.desc: Annotated CDS length in nucleotides, including the terminal stop and summing joined CDS segments rather than the outer genomic span.
lengthNt.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

lengthCodons.label: Protein length
lengthCodons.desc: Number of sense codons in the CDS, excluding the terminal stop; this is the denominator for target fraction. Targets per kilobase instead uses full CDS length in nucleotides, stop included.
lengthCodons.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

neighborUpstreamNt.label: Upstream-neighbor distance
neighborUpstreamNt.desc: Strand-aware distance in nucleotides from the CDS to its upstream coding neighbor on the circular replicon; negative values denote overlap and null is never coerced to zero.
neighborUpstreamNt.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

neighborDownstreamNt.label: Downstream-neighbor distance
neighborDownstreamNt.desc: Strand-aware distance in nucleotides from the CDS to its downstream coding neighbor on the circular replicon; negative values denote overlap and null is never coerced to zero.
neighborDownstreamNt.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

operonPosition.label: Operon position
operonPosition.desc: One-based transcription-order position within a predicted same-strand operon; null for singleton genes. Operons are inferred from adjacent CDSs separated by at most 100 nt, not measured experimentally.
operonPosition.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median

operonSize.label: Operon size
operonSize.desc: Number of genes in the predicted same-strand operon; at least 1. Operons are inferred from adjacent CDSs separated by at most 100 nt, not measured experimentally.
operonSize.missingPolicy: null renders as unknown, never as zero or median
